snowpoint_npc_f.name: Woman
dialog: I'm combing every inch of this snow with my Dowsing Machine.
Things dropped in a blizzard get buried in no time. You wouldn't believe what turns up out here!

trainer.name: Shawn
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Shawn: Three Snover, all ready to bury you in snow! Here we go!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Shawn: All three of them buried instead. Under their own snow!

trainer.name: Lexie
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Lexie: My Eevee grew into a Glaceon right here, beside the rock covered in ice! Want to see how strong it is?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Lexie: Even beaten, my Glaceon sparkles like fresh frost.

trainer.name: Bjorn
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Bjorn: Snow in my face and the wind at my back! Quick, battle me before I freeze solid!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Bjorn: Now I'm frozen solid and beaten.

trainer.name: Madison
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Madison: Round and round I go in the snow! Try not to get dizzy watching me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Madison: Whoa... now I'm the dizzy one.

trainer.name: Matthew
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Matthew: That snowdrift you nearly trod on? It was me! Battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Matthew: Hiding in the snow is really, really cold.

trainer.name: Ethan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Ethan: Brrr! I've been lying under the snow for hours, waiting for someone to come by!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Ethan: All that waiting, and over so quickly. Achoo!

trainer.name: Luke
trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Luke: Training in a blizzard toughens the body and the spirit! Face me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Luke: My body is tough enough. My spirit needs more work.

trainer.name: Dalton
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Dalton: Lightning and fire: just the pair for a frozen road. Let's warm things up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Dalton: Not even fire could thaw a loss like that.

trainer.name: Olivia
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Olivia: It's a long trudge through the snow to the lake. A battle will keep me going!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Olivia: That was worth stopping for. Now, on to the lake!
